thought.text: Ternyata ada **Turnstile** juga, di langkah kedua (`protect-check`). Tapi Turnstile Cloudflare di halaman terpisah biasanya lebih ringan — bisa lolos otomatis. Saya uji apakah lolos sendiri.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && DISPLAY=:99 timeout 280 python3 - <<'PY' 2>&1 | tail -25
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import time
email=f"vt{int(time.time())}@sinaja.cyou"
print("email:",email)
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b=p.chromium.launch(headless=False,args=["--no-sandbox"])
    ctx=b.new_context(viewport={"width":1366,"height":900})
    pg=ctx.new_page()
    pg.goto("https://venice.ai/sign-up",wait_until="domcontentloaded",timeout=60000)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(5000)
    pg.fill('input[name="emailAddress"]',email)
    pg.fill('input[name="password"]',"Str0ng!Pass123")
    pg.click("text=Continue")
    for i in range(12):
        pg.wait_for_timeout(5000)
        u=pg.url
        tk=pg.evaluate("(document.querySelector('[name=cf-turnstile-response]')||{}).value||''")
        print(f"[{i}] {u[-45:]} token={len(tk)}")
        if "protect-check" not in u: break
        if len(tk)>0:
            # coba klik lanjut jika ada
            try:
                pg.click("text=Continue",timeout=3000); print("   klik Continue")
            except Exception: pass
    print("FINAL URL:",pg.url)
    print("BODY:",pg.inner_text("body")[:400].replace("\n"," | "))
    b.close()
PY
